youtube.title: A Hebrew emblem traced to vectors, its text kept live: 97/100 against the reference
youtube.description:
funkbox's image_trace turned this emblem into a vector SVG, lifted the lettering out of the artwork and set the words back on top as live text layers; the text audit checks every string exactly. Scored against the reference with poster_compare: 97/100, and 97/100 for each of two mashups.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
